title: The customer card on a work order is unchanged
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'View and Manage AP/AR Data', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Use the staging site with the Tiered Pricing release (and the Tiered Pricing QA site too, once it exists); production is not needed.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, on tier A for work orders.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1's customer card shows the same rows as today (Today picture).
  • It has no Pricing section and no tier rows.
